Rang utna hi hai, toh yeh barabar bhinn hain. Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Ab kitne mein se kitne hisse rangeen hain?

Ab ek patti ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 8 rangeen hain. Do-do hisse mila kar bade hisse banaye: naya bhinn kya hai?

Sirf numbers dekh kar nahi keh sakte ki bhinn bada hai. 1/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaato, toh 3/12 banta hai: numbers bade hain, par rang utna hi. Hisse mila kar dekhenge, rang utna hi hai ya nahi. Dono pattiyon ko kitne bade hisson mein milaoge, ki rangeen bhi poore milein?

director.text: Yeh jawab nahi hai. Dono ko 4 bade hisson mein laayenge: 8 aur 12 dono 4 barabar hisson mein mil jaate hain. Pehli patti ke do-do hisse milaye: 4 bade hisse bane, aur 6 rangeen mil kar 3. Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

mujhe cricket pasand hai

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh bhinn wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain. Pehle 3/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaata tha: neeche 4 × 3 = 12, upar 3 × 3 = 9. Haan, sahi hai. 40 ÷ 8 = 5, toh neeche bhi 56 ÷ 8 = 7: 5/7. Ab bhaag wala raasta aage le jaayenge: kisi bhinn ko sabse chhote numbers tak, yaani lowest terms tak. Yahan tak theek hai?

Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
